description: This file defines a UserController class with methods for creating, reading, updating, and testing user-related API endpoints, utilizing Express.js request/response handling and external user service.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller class handling user-related API requests such as create, read, update, and test.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles user creation requests, calls UserService.createUser with request body, returns created user.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves user by ID or email based on query parameters, removes sensitive fields before responding.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user information if authorized, calls UserService.updateUser.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Simple test endpoint returning a greeting message.
